_comment: Each series keeps one open round (or pair). When its entry window closes, the scheduler opens the next one. Blocks: ~0.3 s on Monad testnet (1 h = 12000). Keep durationBlocks a bit below entryBlocks, so the previous position on the same market is closed before the next one opens.

rounds.description: Quick round: SOL goes up in 15 minutes. The prize pool trades a 10x SOL long on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Strike: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above strike wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: BTC in the next 6 hours: up or down? Pick a side. Bulls side, 15x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Strike: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above strike: Bulls win. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: BTC in the next 6 hours: up or down? Pick a side. Bears side, 15x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Strike: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Below strike: Bears win. Your money always comes back.
